messages:
Maya: Noticed several tenants reporting preview token counts ~40% lower than last week, but final invoices look normal. This started after we enabled ingest-sampling in the preview pipeline.

Jonah: Confirmed. We rolled out preview-side sampling to reduce storage/preview compute costs. It was supposed to be approximate and flagged, but the console shows raw totals without an "estimate" badge for some customers.

Priya: Which sampling mode did we enable? We have two: probabilistic event-sample and session-sample.

Jonah: We enabled probabilistic event-sample at 0.6 keep-rate for preview only, intended to speed up charts. Billing uses full stream, no sampling.

Lili: From billing side, invoices are generated from canonicalized full events. The discrepancy is expected but customers seeing previews think invoices are wrong. We need clearer UX and maybe different defaults.

Maya: Did we communicate this anywhere? I don't recall a banner.

ConsoleBot: Deployment note: feature flag preview_ingest_sampling rolled 2024-07-02 09:12 UTC. Only activated in preview ingestion service in us-west.

QA Bot: Regression found: console preview charts do not toggle the "estimated" marker when preview_ingest_sampling is true. Test case missing.

Priya: Short-term options:
- Turn off sampling globally until we have explicit UX
- Add prominent "estimated" badge and tooltip explaining sampling and expected variance
- Add preview_vs_invoice delta alert for tenants >$500/mo

Jonah: Cost impact: sampling saved ~28% CPU on preview ingestion. Turning it off will add back that cost.

Lili: We can't risk customer trust. I'd prefer turning off sampling for customers with visible invoice preview links (enterprise tenants) and keep sampling for internal preview to save cost.

Maya: We can scope the flag: sample=false for tenants with billing_tier >= enterprise or with preview enabled in console. I'll open a rollout patch.

Priya: UX: console should show a chart overlay when sampling is active, show effective keep-rate, and a link to a status note. Also mark any preview numbers as "estimate".

ConsoleBot: Adding console issue: CONS-892. Will wire the overlay and badge. ETA 2 days.

QA Bot: Adding tests: preview-chart should render estimate badge when sample header present; preview-vs-final test to run in nightly.

OncallBot: Created PAGE-3801 to track immediate scope change, paging infra for flag update.

Jonah: I'll add tenant-aware gating to sampling and a telemetry metric that reports preview_keep_rate per tenant. That'll help monitor unexpected changes.

Lili: Also add audit log entries when preview sampling toggles for a tenant — CS needs that for customer tickets.

Maya: Action items: Jonah scope flag by tenant and add telemetry, ConsoleBot implement badge/overlay, QA Bot add testcases, Lili draft comms and update CS playbook, Oncall flip flag for enterprise tenants to false.

Priya: One more ask: add an opt-in for customers who want cheap previews (sampling) vs exact previews. Make it explicit in billing settings.

Maya: Good point. Add to product backlog. For now prioritize gating and UX.

Jonah: Will open PRs for gating + telemetry and include a dry-run rollout to 5 internal tenants first.

Maya: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread and post to #customer-facing if any customer tickets spike.
